lawAmendment.note: D5: must merge before any SFV4-getsomes-struct sweep or codemod runs.

policyRatchet.note: G4: per-owner/family blocking flag consulted by schemaFirstLintHasFailures (packages/tooling/tool/cli/src/commands/Lint/SchemaFirst.ts:1464-1477). New cards land non-blocking; each family flips to blocking after its wave goes yeet-verify-green.

sharedAssignment.rationale: packages/shared/{domain,tables} are consumed exclusively by slice packages (agents, architecture-lab, epistemic, law-practice, workspace) and apps/professional-desktop; upstream deps are foundation-only (identity, schema, utils). Shared kernel rides the apps-slices wave so its public-form changes and consumer sweeps stay inside one family.

infraAssignment.rationale: @beep/infra has zero workspace dependents and depends on foundation + @beep/repo-ai-metrics (tooling); it is an operational surface maintained alongside tooling, so it rides the tooling wave.

pilot.rationale: GOAL-suggested foundation/modeling exemplar; 10 actionable findings spread across S1/S2/S4/S5 (S3 clean) — meaty enough to exercise the parity-proof + round-trip-law machinery, small enough to converge fast.

_note: Populated during P1 baseline, one entry per package touched, mirroring goals/effect-native-migration/ops/progress.json's resumable per-package model. Each package entry shape: { "path": "packages/...", "sanitized": "beep__<name>", "family": "foundation|drivers|tooling|apps-slices", "discovery": "pending|in_progress|done", "remediation": "pending|in_progress|blocked|exception|done", "findingsByDomain": { "S1": 0, "S2": 0, "S3": 0, "S4": 0, "S5": 0 }, "actionableCount": 0, "exceptionCount": 0, "parityProofRef": null, "policyFlipped": false, "remediationNote": "" }. Reconcile against this file before each wave; skip packages already "done". `findingsByDomain` counts come from the §5.5 inventory records at ops/inventory/<Sn>/<sanitized-pkg>.json; `actionableCount` excludes ledgered exceptions; `policyFlipped` tracks whether this package's family has had its lint cards flipped advisory->blocking in standards/schema-crispening.policy.jsonc (G4/§5.7).

scopeNotes.targetSurfaces: First-party source under packages/**, apps/**, and infra/** (infra/**/*.ts is inside SchemaFirst.ts INCLUDED_GLOBS), minus generated code (.repos/**, **/dist/**, **/build/**, node_modules/**, docgen output).
scopeNotes.canonicalFamilyKeys: foundation | drivers | tooling | apps-slices — machine keys used by this file, standards/schema-crispening.policy.jsonc, and ops/inventory/; 'apps/slices' in prose is display-only.
scopeNotes.sharedKernelSeam: packages/shared/* and infra/** wave assignments are decided during P1 baseline, not pre-assigned here (see sharedAssignment/infraAssignment above); until assigned they are non-blocking, and every finding must end up inside some family's ratchet.
scopeNotes.populationMethod: P1 discovery agents (S1-S5) populate packages{} from their per-package inventories; do not hand-author entries before P1 runs.
